User review actual 4. Keep this a display projection over supplied drawn group and posterior-argmax group; omit agreements visually while retaining all records and complete accounting. Treat missing/no group as unknown, not agreement. Independent coding is a distinct optional comparator, absent legend when not supplied. Choose a readable strip with explicit ordinal group semantics, useful endpoint glyphs and selected-unit inspection; no time or distance interpretation attached to group spacing. Acceptance: synthetic agree/disagree/unknown/coding cases; selected identity and original group spans/values survive switching; monochrome origin, external-dominant and coarse-support encodings remain. Compare on real NN03 with the current track and show the new information plainly.

Reuse the existing Voyage document/compiler/lowering/view; no new frontend or view-side scientific inference. Preserve semantic identities, supplied values, origin shapes, external-dominant hollows, group-level support and existing inspector exact text. Do not add native media boundaries or evidence links without checked producer capabilities. Record exact revision/artifact tuple and run affected Scala gates plus real-browser and synthetic failure witnesses. Existing frozen Sherlock artifacts are regression inputs, not scientific validation. Rollback: disable the new display/control and retain the existing checked Voyage route; never rewrite original artifacts. An actual Intaglio deficiency belongs in ~/code/scala/intaglio with its own Mote ticket and producer-consumer witness. No renderer defect is established by this ticket.
set.title: [Voyage] Replace the redundant group staircase with disagreement-only inspection
